issues.issue: Aluat is a concrete familiar flour-and-liquid preparation. Its five existing incoming ingredients/tools are factual: flour, water, yeast, rolling pin and kitchen mixer. Dr Oetker illustrates flour/liquid/yeast with mechanical kneading; dictionary meaning supplies the independent lexical signal. Not every dough requires yeast. The naive flour opener is direct/hot; bread being only lukewarm is retained as a limitation, not concealed. No specialist or regional knowledge is required. Sources: https://www.oetker.ro/retete/r/pizza ; https://dexonline.ro/definitie/aluat

Cașcaval is a familiar semi-hard cheese, with ordinary milk/cheese/pizza/sandwich associations. Napolact and Hochland are independent Romanian producer signals of ordinary food use. Cașcaval de Săveni PGI in the existing description is independently verified by EU Implementing Regulation2021/657 and the Commission Romanian notice; this does not grant PGI to generic cașcaval. Familiarity does not depend on knowing that designation. The live direct cheese and two-hop milk approaches are meaningful. Sources: https://www.napolact.ro/cascaval ; https://hochland.ro/produse/ ; https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/RO/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32021R0657 ; https://romania.representation.ec.europa.eu/stiri-evenimente-si-resurse-pentru-presa/stiri/cascavalul-de-saveni-produs-cu-indicatie-geografica-protejata-ue-2021-04-22_ro
